===== 3 # HB-03 · Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions
version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-06-01
§1 Purpose
This memo lists group exceptions to the nightly lodging limit in HB-22. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.
§2 Exception for business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo
For business trips to Zurich, Geneva or Oslo, the nightly lodging limit is 270 EUR per night instead of the standard amount. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.
§3 Carve-out
The exception above does not apply to contractors; they follow the standard nightly lodging limit in HB-22 §2. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim.
§4 Review

===== 4 # HB-04 · Related budgets: meals
version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
§1 Scope
This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the daily meal allowance. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.
§2 Central budget
Team lunches during internal workshops are paid from the workshop budget, which allows 87 EUR per participant per workshop. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim.
§3 Contacts
The finance team answers questions about these budgets. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here.

===== 5 # HB-05 · Related budgets: training budget
version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
§1 Scope
This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the annual training budget. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.
§2 Central budget
Conference attendance is funded by the department conference pool, which reserves 1650 EUR per department each year. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims.
§3 Contacts
The finance team answers questions about these budgets. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
§1 Purpose
This memo lists group exceptions to the home-office equipment allowance in HB-11. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.
§2 Exception for employees with a medical accessibility plan
For employees with a medical accessibility plan, the home-office equipment allowance is 750 EUR instead of the standard amount. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted.
§3 Carve-out
The exception above does not apply to part-time employees working fewer than 20 hours a week; they follow the standard home-office equipment allowance in HB-11 §2. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.
